sections.headline: Conversations Over Coffee

items.author: Julian R.
items.quote: The cortado here rivals anything I've had in Italy. The handmade terracotta mugs and minimalist aesthetic make every visit a joy.

items.author: Sarah M.
items.quote: My daily sanctuary. The staff genuinely remembers my order, and the ambient noise is perfectly calibrated for morning focus.

items.author: Marcus T.
items.quote: Finally, a cafe in the neighborhood that balances exceptional, nerdy espresso standards with warm, unpretentious hospitality.

sections.headline: Common Inquiries
sections.subheadline: Details about our sourcing, space, and offerings.

items.question: Do you roast your own coffee?
items.answer: We partner with a close-knit group of local artisanal roasters and feature a rotating single-origin guest bean on espresso every month.

items.question: Are there vegan pastry options?
items.answer: Yes, our daily bakery selection always includes at least two plant-based goods, including our signature citrus olive oil loaf.

items.question: Is the cafe suitable for remote work?
items.answer: Laptops are welcome at our communal oak tables and the window bar. We intentionally keep our intimate booths device-free to encourage conversation.

items.question: Can I purchase beans to brew at home?
items.answer: Absolutely. We sell retail bags of our staple house blend alongside limited micro-lots, and we are happy to grind them to your exact brewer specifications.
